connector.name: Gerrit Code Review
connector.registryDescription: Capability-gated Gerrit code review tools with opt-in review notifications pushed into the session
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image go-gerrit-mcp:1.1.3. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace team.gaijin. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GERRIT_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Gerrit instance

env.name: GERRIT_TOKEN
env.description: HTTP password or token of the account

env.name: GERRIT_MCP_GROUPS
env.description: Comma-separated capability groups to enable: read, comment, transition

env.name: GERRIT_MCP_PROJECTS
env.description: Comma-separated Gerrit project allowlist confining every operation

env.name: GERRIT_MCP_OWN_CHANGES_ONLY
env.description: Refuse trail-leaving operations on changes not owned by the authenticated account

env.name: GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS
env.description: Enable review notifications: poll Gerrit for activity on subscribed changes and push it into the agent's session (requires a client with channel support)

env.name: GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_POLL_INTERVAL
env.description: Poll cadence for subscribed changes, as a Go duration

env.name: GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_INCLUDE_OWN
env.description: Keep the authenticated account's own activity in review notifications

env.name: GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_EXCLUDE_ACCOUNTS
env.description: Comma-separated usernames or numeric account IDs whose activity never becomes a review notification

env.name: GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS
env.description: Comma-separated regular expressions; matching message or comment text never becomes a review notification
